description: Public experiment definitions only. Keep merchant exports and private operational readings outside the repository.

bets.metric: Per DE/NL/AU category cohort: human page_view events, need_selected, need_result, merchant outbound. Exclude QA, bots and DNT/GPC. Merchant-confirmed net commissions remain a separate source.
bets.threshold: First 30 live days: at least 100 qualified visits per market before judging content; then >=10 guide-result clicks and >=5 merchant clicks is a continuation signal, not statistical proof or revenue. No reach = distribution inconclusive.
bets.win: Deepen the market/constraint with measured demand. Monetize NL/AU only after verified local affiliate enrollment and tracking ID. Validate EPC from matched merchant reports before scaling.
bets.lose: If >=100 qualified visits and no guide-result or merchant clicks, revise entry intent and buying fit once; do not add more pages to that cluster. Unknown attribution or commissions blocks revenue claims.
bets.queue_note: The measurement/placement part of this older unbuilt topic is delivered by this public pilot. Recheck cannibalization before any separate calibration page; do not duplicate the measurement guide.
